title: Package autonomy, external dependency isolation, and authoritative reuse
objective: Record the owner's repository-wide rules for consumer-agnostic capabilities, third-party API isolation behind the smallest useful Grafting-owned boundary, minimal package count, and prohibition of duplicated authoritative logic.
validations: manual decision and exception consistency review passed
fork provenance, license, maintenance, naming, and rollback criteria recorded
x6-canvas declaration audit passed with no @antv/x6 type leakage
repository scan confirmed @antv/x6 has one owning runtime import
coordination validation and control-plane audit passed
Graph IR generation/freshness and git diff checks passed
risks: Literal zero textual repetition would undermine independent tests and create premature abstractions; the rule applies to authoritative behavior and meaning.
Wrapping native toolchains and build-only dependencies would add indirection without isolating a runtime API; they are explicitly outside the runtime boundary rule.
A cloned or modified third-party codebase needs explicit license, provenance, update, and security maintenance before it becomes an owned fork.
